brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single-cell hexagonal enclosure: piece:0,0,0;full with cover:0,0,0;full;top on top and 6 solid end caps (cap:0,0,0;*;*) sealing open faces; lockJoints applied.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre installed in wall slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0 = hex-port-louvre) – vents without letting rain in.

finish.summary: Built a 1-cell closed hex enclosure (full base + top cover + 6 caps) with a hex-port-louvre in one wall for ventilation. Dressed with electronics props (cable coil, multimeter, solder reel) to show use.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.
